description: Two independent, large (>10% of the page each) images touching along a narrow strip of an edge (overlapRatio ~3.6%) — unlike extract-cluster (a small icon inside a large base).

expected.note: Construction fact: 2 image XObjects, each >10% of the page area, whose bboxes overlap on a narrow strip (overlapRatio ~3.6% of the smaller one's area). groupIntoUnits (buildImageExtraction.ts) should NOT merge this pair into one extraction unit despite the overlapping bboxes — it should give TWO separate units. Before this fix (clusterByOverlap without extraMergeGate) it gave ONE unit whose bbox union also covered the space between the images (observed on a real rulebook page as 'an image containing a picture and text').
